environment: local repository snapshot; no deployed URL
applicability_reason: The target appears consumer-facing, but the moment and medium of contract formation are unknown.
expected: The operator documents whether distance-contract rules apply and, if so, provides accurate precontractual information and durable confirmation before the consumer is bound.
observed: The current phase excludes online checkout/payment but plans direct channels; no service terms, prices, trader identity, cancellation, withdrawal or complaint model is approved.
method: Client-document and architecture review against the consolidated TRLGDCU scope and precontractual provisions.
preconditions: The present UI must not create a payment obligation.
limitations: No actual Telegram, WhatsApp or phone operating script or contract was provided.
impact: A future contact channel could bind consumers without required identity, price, conditions, confirmation or remedy information.
prevalence: Every enabled reservation/contact channel and its operating process.

source_refs.legal_effect: Spanish consumer regime for B2C and distance contracts within scope.
source_refs.applicability_reason: The planned flow may coordinate a service with individuals at a distance.
source_refs.verification_method: Official BOE consolidated text and client-flow comparison.

false_positive_analysis: No online checkout, payment or active endpoint exists, so there is no observed binding web button; off-site formation remains unresolved.
counterevidence: The client explicitly excluded online booking and payment from this phase.
remediation_minimum: Map offer, acceptance, payment, cancellation, confirmation and complaints across every channel; have counsel determine applicable information and withdrawal rules; implement only the approved model.
additional_hardening: Add a channel-level release checklist and preserve durable evidence of the consumer information version shown.
retest: Run a staging journey through each approved channel without payment and compare every information point to the approved contract map.
residual_risk: Unknown until the commercial process is defined; keep all channels fail-closed.
